attributes.action: Require Firework Use to Be Registered in Advance So Animal Owners Can Prepare
attributes.additional_details: After years of watching my dog suffer, shake, hyperventilate and whimper in fear, I’m tired of having to watch her go through this. It’s not just one night, but weeks of stress. We’ve tried everything, including anxiety medication from the vet, but nothing works.Animals don’t understand what these noises are. Imagine hearing explosions four times louder than we do without knowing what they are. It’s time to make a change while still allowing people to enjoy fireworks.
attributes.background: Require people to register firework usage on a website with their area in advance to allow pet owners to plan and manage this. No ban, just preparation. Things that this could help with may include moving your pet to a different location for the night, or ensuring anxiety meds are ready.

rejection.details:
What you suggest in your petition would almost certainly fall under the ambit of local government responsibility rather than central government responsibility.

In addition, we already have some petitions open on fireworks, which you may be interested in signing:

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349
